plan.title: Huế culture day (1 Dec 2026): Imperial City, Nguyễn tombs, Thiên Mụ pagoda and local food

activities.reason: Top culture interest match: the Nguyễn imperial citadel (Đại Nội), tagged sightseeing/culture. Scheduled inside the dataset's winter window 07:00–17:30 (1 Dec falls in the 10-16→03-15 winter season). Price copied exactly from dataset (200,000 VND/person); priceScope is listed as unverified, so cost status is UNVERIFIED.

Culture-tagged Nguyễn royal palace (Cung An Định) close to the citadel, inside its reported daily hours 07:00–17:00. Price 50,000 VND/person taken as-is from the dataset; note the documented price conflict between sources (see missingData).

Lunch stop for Huế heritage food (hến/cơm hến), culture-tagged. Dataset reported hours 07:00–22:00 cover the slot. Per-person average copied exactly (17,500 VND); priceStatus is ESTIMATED, so UNVERIFIED.

Culture highlight: lăng Khải Định, tagged sightseeing/culture. Scheduled inside the dataset winter hours 07:00–17:30 (ticket sales reported to 17:00). Price copied exactly from dataset (150,000 VND/person); priceScope is flagged unverified.

Culture-tagged Thiên Mụ pagoda on the Hương river; dataset reports ALWAYS (24/7) hours, which is a dataset report only, not independently verified. Admission reported as 0 VND; priceScope is flagged unverified in the dataset.

Late-afternoon Huế dessert stop (Chè Cầm), culture-tagged; slot starts after the dataset's reported opening at 16:00 and ends before 22:00. Per-person average copied exactly (15,000 VND); priceStatus is ESTIMATED.

Dinner of Huế home-style rice dishes (Cơm niêu chạn), culture-tagged; inside dataset hours 08:00–22:00. Per-person average copied exactly (275,000 VND); priceStatus is ESTIMATED and priceScope is unspecified in the dataset.

missingData: Visit duration is not provided (durationMin is null) for every attraction and dining place used; all activity time blocks are planning placeholders to be confirmed.

The dataset travelMatrix gives null durationMin and null distanceKm for every origin/destination pair (marked 'routing evidence required'), so all travel legs are output as null; route feasibility and transfer times between the scheduled places are unverified.
Đại Nội (ATTR_H_03): openingHours is the winter frame only; the dataset notes ticket sales may end earlier (07:00–17:00 in openingHoursBySeason) than the 17:30 closing time.

Cung An Định (ATTR_H_02): price conflict in the dataset — 50,000 VND/person (Hue tourism portal) vs 25,000 VND (Vinpearl article quoted in link.txt); current price to be confirmed before buying tickets.
Cung An Định (ATTR_H_02): winter hours 07:00–17:00 are reported but the source does not state the seasonal switch dates.
lăng Khải Định (ATTR_H_01): distanceFromCenter.durationMin is flagged unverified; no verified travel time to/from other places.
Chùa Thiên Mụ (ATTR_H_09): 'ALWAYS / 24/7' is a single reported claim (Klook); it is not independently verified and ritual areas may have their own rules.

Quán hến Hoa Đông (REST_H_04): priceScope is unspecified and the address differs between sources (64 Ưng Bình vs 64 kiệt 7 Ưng Bình); per-person average vs the published 15,000–20,000 VND range needs confirming.
Chè Cầm (REST_H_09): reported hours 16:00–22:00 come from one article (iVIVU); not venue-verified. Price is 'from 15,000 VND/cup', so actual cost depends on the cup chosen.

Cơm niêu chạn (REST_H_06): priceScope is unspecified in the dataset (MIA.vn gives only a 50,000–250,000 VND reference range; the 275,000 VND per-person figure comes from a 4–5 dish meal published by VnExpress) — confirm menu and portions.
Opening hours for ATTR_H_01, ATTR_H_02, ATTR_H_03 are REPORTED/provisional dataset values, not confirmed real-world operating hours for 2026-12-01.
assumptions: 2026-12-01 falls inside the dataset's winter season for seasonal opening hours (10-16 to 03-15), so winter frames are used for Đại Nội, Cung An Định and lăng Khải Định.
Because no durationMin is published, each stop is given a planning time block with buffer between stops; the buffers stand in for the unknown transfer times from the travelMatrix.
estimatedCostVnd values are the dataset per-person prices copied exactly and are NOT multiplied by the 2 travellers or by any number of days.
Prices marked UNVERIFIED reflect dataset flags (priceStatus ESTIMATED or priceScope/unverified fields), not a recalculation.
Selection is driven by the priority-1 interest 'culture': curated attractions tagged sightseeing/culture plus culture-tagged local dining; no transportation mode was requested, so none is assumed.
All listed items are within the stated 3,000,000 VND group budget on the basis of the dataset prices, but no total is asserted here; the server remains responsible for verification.

assumptions: Midpoint of published ranges is a demo estimate, not a measured mean.
Only meals scheduled in this plan are counted; a snack may not be a full meal.
Hotel nights = durationDays - 1; travelers share rooms as adults up to published capacity.
Hotel from-price is not a dated booking; taxes, surcharges and availability remain unconfirmed.
Transport from departure is not estimated here. Feasibility and verified totals are unchanged.
